exposure: Idiopathic polyhydramnios (normal AFI, mild polyhydramnios, moderate-severe polyhydramnios)
cohort: 10,536 pregnancies with an amniotic fluid index (AFI) measurement ≥24 + 0 weeks' gestation
finding: Idiopathic polyhydramnios is independently associated with increased risks of several morbidities, including NICU admission, postpartum hemorrhage, macrosomia, low 5-minute Apgar score, and Cesarean delivery.
